$comment: Hand overrides for Trekmore's AI profile (docs/cpu-guide/04 sections 4 and 8; heavy playstyle defaults, docs/TREKMORE_PLAN.md F W3b). tags: ftilt and dtilt are his spacing pokes at sword reach (neutral role; the derive gave him only the sword there); dsmash is not an edgeguard tool (the sword and dair are). spacingMul 0.95 holds spacing just inside the ftilt tip. preferredHolds: tap, half and full sword. slots, read by src/ai/characters/trekmore.ts: approachStep (approach with the Shadow Step instead of the run, bonus weight), dthrowEcho (dthrow into the table's echo follow-up, bonus weight), edgeguardSword and edgeguardDair (edgeguard plans on), counterKillAtFloor and counterKillAtCap (percent at which the counter's repaid hit kills a fresh Aeval at the counter floor and cap, balance loop 0 in moves.ts), counterComboBelow (percent under which the counter launch is followable), counterWhiffLoss (damage a whiffed counter concedes, for the break-even).
